english.title: Fail to comply with requirement imposed by section 99ZA, 99ZB or 99ZC of the Transport Act 1968
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement imposed on you by **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), an officer authorised by the Transport Act 1968, exercising a power

(A)_[of inspection of records or premises under section 99ZA of the Act]_
(B)_[of entry into a vehicle under section 99ZB of the Act]_
(C)_[requiring the signing of a hard copy of data under section 99ZC of the Act]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99ZD(1)(a) and (2) of the Transport Act 1968.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Three hundred pounds

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
